'''Henry Vernon Wong''' is a Jamaican-American [[physicist]] known for his work in [[Plasma (physics)|plasma physics]]. He is professor emeritus at the [[University of Texas, Austin]].

== Career ==
Wong's early education was at [[Cornwall College, Jamaica|Cornwall College]] in [[Montego Bay]], [[Jamaica]]. He won a Jamaica Scholarship to the [[University of the West Indies]], graduating with a B.Sc. in physics in 1961.<ref name=hist1>{{cite web|url=https://web2.ph.utexas.edu/utphysicshistory/VernonWong.html|title=History of the University of Texas at Austin Department of Physics|accessdate=Aug 20, 2020|archive-date=May 22, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220522211742/https://web2.ph.utexas.edu/utphysicshistory/VernonWong.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> He obtained his D.Phil. in [[nuclear physics]] from [[Wadham College]], [[Oxford University|Oxford]] in 1964. Wong remained at Oxford during 1964–1965 as a postdoctoral scholar. In 1965, he was the recipient of a CIBA Fellowship to continue his research at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in [[Trieste]], [[Italy]]. The following year he joined the Laboratoria Gas Ionizzati in [[Rome]]. In 1967, Wong joined the Fusion Research Center (FRC) of the [[University of Texas at Austin]] as a research scientist.<ref name=hist2>{{cite web|url=https://web2.ph.utexas.edu/utphysicshistory/InstituteForFusionStudies.html|title=University of Texas Institute for Fusion Studies (IFS)|accessdate=Aug 20, 2020|archive-date=August 11, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811094928/http://web2.ph.utexas.edu/utphysicshistory/InstituteForFusionStudies.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
*In 1961, Wong was awarded a [[Rhodes Scholarship]] to [[Wadham College]], [[Oxford]]<ref name=uwi>{{cite web|url=https://www.uwi.edu/alumnionline/alumni-central/points-pride/rhodes-scholars|title= University of the West Indies Rhodes Scholars|date= 10 July 2010|accessdate=Aug 20, 2020}}</ref><ref name=rhodes>{{cite web|url=https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/alumni-volunteers/rhodes-scholar-database/|title=Rhodes Scholar Database|accessdate=Aug 20, 2020}}</ref>
*In 1988, He was elected fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref name=aps>{{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=W|title= Fellows of the American Physical Society|accessdate=Aug 20, 2020}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*Wong, H. Vernon. "Stability of Bernstein‐Greene‐Kruskal Wave with Small Fraction of Trapped Electrons" ''[[The Physics of Fluids]]'' 15, 632 (1972); [https://doi.org/10.1063/1.1693958 DOI:10.1063/1.1693958]
*Wong, H. Vernon. "Sideband instabilities in free electron lasers" ''[[Physics of Fluids|Physics of Fluids B: Plasma Physics]]'', 2 1635 (1990). [https://doi.org/10.1063/1.859489 DOI:10.1063/1.859489]
*Wong, H. Vernon. "Particle canonical variables and guiding center Hamiltonian up to second order in the Larmor radius" ''[[Physics of Plasmas]]'' 7, 73 (2000). [https://doi.org/10.1063/1.873782 DOI:10.1063/1.873782]
*Wong, H. Vernon. "Nonlinear finite-Larmor-radius drift-kinetic equation" ''[[Physics of Plasmas]]'' 12, 112305 (2005). [https://doi.org/10.1063/1.2116867 DOI:10.1063/1.2116867]
